patthana23.5:1.1: na kusalaṃ na savitakkasavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo savitakkasavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava.
patthana23.5:2.1: na kusalaṃ na avitakkavicāramattaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca akusalo avitakkavicāramatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā nava.
patthana23.5:3.1: na kusalaṃ na avitakkaavicāraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato avitakkaavicāro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dvādasa. nakusalattika napītittike kusalattika pītittikaṃ
